summary: Credit Suisse Commercial Mortgage Securities Corp., as depositor for CSAIL 2019-C18 Commercial Mortgage Trust, filed an 8-K on September 21, 2026, reporting that Situs Holdings, LLC was removed as special servicer of the ILPT Industrial Portfolio Mortgage Loan. Argentic Services Company LP was appointed successor special servicer under the MSC 2019-L3 PSA. The loan represented approximately 5.0% of the issuing entity's asset pool at cut-off and is part of a loan combination. No economic terms, board recommendation, or advisor were disclosed. This is a routine servicing change, not a special situation; watch for potential loan workout developments.
